excludedObservations.reason: 12px/600ms的慢小位移进入长按菜单，含分享联系人；立即E145关闭。全部画面、层级、录像不公开，不纳入动效数值分析。

projection.emulatorSource: MuMu host and established task provenance; spoofed OEM model is not a physical-device claim

feedReturn.limit: 两次截图间经历图集手势、一次主图单击尝试、评论/输入界面、详情滚动和系统返回；E149单击主图后的终态仍是详情，本轮没有成功进入独立图片查看器。这不是干净一次进入即返回的因果实验。不能推出自动滚动规则或恢复算法。

directReentryControl.limit: 这次直接重进再返回没有再次位移，是每次返回都固定移动639px这一猜测的反例；仍不能确定第一次位移原因。

limits: single emulator, one app version, same long-lived process
input paths are ADB single-pointer requests, not finger motion measurements
exact thresholds, haptics, real touch latency, multi-touch, weak network and lifecycle remain untested
E144 is excluded; no original UI/media/content uploaded
